fact_text: Foreign nationals and overseas Koreans who reside in Korea and work at an insured company are compulsorily enrolled in the National Health Insurance as employee insured; enrolment can be excluded only if equivalent medical coverage is proven under a foreign law, foreign insurance, or an employer contract.
evidence_quote: Foreigners and overseas Koreans residing and working at the insured company are compulsorily subscribed.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a corporate private or international health plan lets you skip Korea's state scheme. Actually enrolment in the National Health Insurance is compulsory for foreign employees, with an opt-out only where equivalent cover is proven. Action: budget for NHIS payroll deductions from your first pay run and seek exclusion only with documented equivalent coverage.

entity_title: 6-month rule: mandatory NHIS for foreign residents
fact_text: Any foreigner or overseas Korean who has stayed in Korea for more than six months is subject to mandatory subscription to National Health Insurance as self-employed (locally) insured if not already covered as an employee, which also captures non-working accompanying family.
evidence_quote: Any foreigner or overseas Korean who has stayed in Korea for over six months is subject to mandatory subscription to health insurance(From July 16, 2019)

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed a non-working spouse or dependant can remain uninsured. Actually a foreigner staying over six months is mandatorily enrolled and billed premiums. Action: register accompanying family with NHIS and plan for their premium bills once past six months of stay.

entity_title: NHIS premiums split 50/50 with the employer
fact_text: For the employee insured, the monthly National Health Insurance contribution equals monthly wage times the contribution rate and is paid half by the employee (withheld from salary) and half by the employer.
evidence_quote: Contribution is paid by the employee insured (50%) and the employer (50%).

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed the employer or the state fully funds Korean health cover. Actually the premium is split 50/50 and the employee's half is deducted from salary each month. Action: model roughly half of the NHIS premium as a recurring payroll deduction when estimating net pay.
